solution:
import numpy as np, cv2

def add_sp_and_restore(clean: np.ndarray, prob=0.1):
    np.random.seed(7)
    noisy = clean.copy()
    rnd = np.random.rand(*clean.shape)
    noisy[rnd < prob / 2] = 0
    noisy[(rnd >= prob / 2) & (rnd < prob)] = 255
    return noisy, cv2.medianBlur(noisy, 3)
